# Dhikrer · Zikirci

> A free, ad-free, offline digital dhikr counter (tasbih / tesbih / zikirmatik) for Android and iOS. No account, no analytics, no tracking — everything stays on your device. Trilingual: English, Türkçe, العربية (RTL).

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhikrer.fxerkan.com/): App overview, features, screenshots, user guide, and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dhikrer.fxerkan.com/privacy.html): No account, no analytics, no tracking; all data stays on device.

## Get the app

- [App Store (iOS)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803203796)
- [Google Play (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fxerkan.dhikrer)
